input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Customer, Developer roles. The platform provides capabilities for global rest exception handler, customer, message utility. Secondary concerns include task management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Customer, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to interact with customer ref functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer ref-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to use global rest exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Customer, I want to use customer capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
